viewing_check: Use a loupe on the obverse crown band: six pearls plus centre diamond and the peripheral die breaks either side are the genuine-1923 diagnostics. Check the 3 in the date for tooling (1925/1928 altered). Downies 362 has eight 1923 halfpennies live this week, so supply is not scarce.
